referenceImages.name: AERA log-periodic radio station
referenceImages.scope: Whole lpda radio station: documented orthogonal antenna geometry, mast, electronics, GPS/communications, solar power and cattle fence. Source dimensions retained. Number of dipole elements, rod profiles/visibility thickness, hardware dimensions/arrangement, materials/finish and station positions are original estimates. Known AERAWS point anchors an explicitly estimated anonymous layout; no claimed actual radio GPS/table, WCD substitution or private-data reconstruction.
